description: This file defines a class BIFF8 that provides a mapping from BIFF8 color indices to RGB color codes for handling Excel BIFF8 format colors in PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: BIFF8
classes.description: Provides a color mapping from BIFF8 color indices to RGB hex strings.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns an RGB color array for a given BIFF8 color index, defaulting to black if index not found.
